description: The plot illustrates the WER during fine-tuning of the Whisper model for different configurations, specifically for the "medium" type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, also with a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at every 5 units. The plot contains four lines, each representing a different configuration: "medium_AdaLoRA_int4" (solid green line with diamond markers), "medium_AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed green line with diamond markers), "medium_int4" (solid green line with square markers), and "medium_int8" (dashed green line with square markers). The "medium_AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at approximately 28 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 12 at epoch 6. The "medium_AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at about 30 at epoch 0, peaks at roughly 31 at epoch 1, and then declines to approximately 14 at epoch 6. The "medium_int4" line starts at around 27 at epoch 0 and decreases to about 13 at epoch 6. The "medium_int8" line begins at approximately 29 at epoch 0 and declines to around 15 at epoch 6. All lines generally exhibit a downward trend across the epochs.
